privacy-1: This document is intended to regulate the relationship between Crypton XYZ (the «Administration») and the visitor of the resource (the «User»). It defines the procedure for collecting and using the User's personal information (UPI) and the circumstances of its provision to third parties.
privacy-2: The purpose of UPI collection is to provide access to the data published by the Administration, comply with the law, ensure that the User is informed by email, and improve the provision of services. The Administration can inform the User about the introduction of special offers, the appearance of new products, the provision of services and the consideration of his requests.
privacy-3: The main points of the user agreement:
privacy-4: 1. The Administration collects and processes UPI to protect its legitimate interests - ensuring IT security, taking steps to further develop products and services, initiating litigation, transferring or selling assets.
privacy-5: 2. the Administration may use the user's e-mail address, location and transaction history for advertising campaigns, research and analysis, as well as sending news and special offers. The user can change this option or opt out of receiving the newsletter.
privacy-6: 3. The Administration and third parties it engages for this purpose may collect, process and store UPI in accordance with the laws in force. The purpose of processing is the correct operation of the resource and improvement of the services provided.
privacy-7: 4. The user may request the modification, blocking and deletion of the UPI if this data is inaccurate, incomplete, outdated or illegally obtained.
privacy-8: 5. If the Administration is authorized or compelled to disclose a UPI, it shall disclose only those data necessary to accomplish the purposes of such disclosure.
privacy-9: 6. The Administration may use the services of authorized services for processing and storage of UPI on the basis of the concluded service agreement and UPI protection instructions.
privacy-10: 7. The Administration uses the UPI to provide information about products, services and offers that may be of interest to the user.
privacy-11: 8. In general, UPI are retained from the time they are received until the purpose of processing such information is accomplished.
privacy-12: If the Administration no longer needs to store UPI, it will carefully remove or destroy them within 30 days after the processing goal has been achieved.
privacy-13: Contact details. Address for collecting complaints and suggestions
